# American Academy of Family Physicians (AAFP)

> Professional organization representing 124,500 family physicians with peer-reviewed journals, CME education, clinical resources, and annual conferences.

The AAFP is the primary professional organization for family medicine in the United States, providing clinical education, practice management resources, and leadership development for family physicians. The organization publishes multiple peer-reviewed journals and hosts major conferences including the annual FUTURE conference and Whole Health Summit.

## Key Topics

- Family Medicine
- Continuing Medical Education (CME)
- American Family Physician (AFP)
- AMA PRA Category 1 Credit
- Clinical Topics
- Physician Leadership
- Practice Management
- Whole Health Summit
- FUTURE Conference
- Medical Education
- Lifestyle Medicine
- Physician Burnout
- Telehealth
- Patient-Centered Care
- Professional Development

## Flagship Journals & Publications

- [American Family Physician (AFP)](https://www.aafp.org/pubs/afp.html): Peer-reviewed clinical journal and CME resource for family physicians
- [Family Practice Management (FPM)](https://www.aafp.org/pubs/fpm.html): Peer-reviewed practice improvement journal for family medicine
- [FP Essentials](https://www.aafp.org/pubs/fpe.html): Monthly peer-reviewed clinical monographs with CME credit
- [AFP Clinical Topics by Specialty](https://www.aafp.org/pubs/afp/topics/by-topic.inpatient-medicine.html): AFP clinical topics collection organized by medical specialty
- [AFP Taxonomy](https://www.aafp.org/pubs/afp/collections/taxonomy.fractures.html): Indexed clinical topics and medical conditions reference

## Conferences & Events

- [FUTURE 2026 Conference](https://www.aafp.org/events/national-conference/scholarships.html): Annual family medicine conference in Kansas City, MO with scholarships available
- [Whole Health Summit](https://www.aafp.org/events/whole-health-summit.html): 3-day conference in Charlotte, NC for family physicians on whole health and lifestyle medicine

## CME Education & Credit

- [Family Medicine Update Self-Study](https://www.aafp.org/cme/all/family-medicine-update/self-study.html): Online self-study CME course on clinical topics with CME credit
- [CME Credit Equivalency Agreements](https://www.aafp.org/cme/credit-system/credit-statements/health-professional-organizations-agreement.html): AAFP CME credit equivalency agreements with healthcare organizations
- [International CME Credit Equivalency](https://www.aafp.org/cme/credit-system/credit-statements/cfpc-agreement.html): AAFP CME credit equivalency with international healthcare organizations
- [Course Cancellations and Refunds](https://www.aafp.org/cme/about/cancellations-refunds.html): AAFP cancellation and refund policy for courses and events

## Clinical Guidance & Policy

- [Retail Clinics Policy](https://www.aafp.org/about/policies/all/retail-clinics.html): AAFP policy position on retail clinics for patient-centered healthcare
- [Obstructive Sleep Apnea Screening](https://www.aafp.org/news/health-of-the-public/obstructive-sleep-apnea-2022-draft.html): USPSTF draft recommendation on obstructive sleep apnea screening evidence
- [Telehealth During COVID-19](https://www.aafp.org/news/health-of-the-public/20200323covidtelehealth.html): AAFP guidance on telehealth implementation during COVID-19 pandemic
- [COVID-19 Vaccine Confidence Survey](https://www.aafp.org/news/health-of-the-public/covid-vaccine-survey.html): AAFP survey on family physicians' COVID-19 vaccine confidence and communication
- [Cannabis Use in Older Adults](https://www.aafp.org/news/health-of-the-public/20200304cannabisuse.html): Analysis of cannabis use trends among older adults from national survey

## Physician Profiles & Leadership

- [Dr. Joanna Bisgrove: Self-Advocacy to Family Medicine Advocacy](https://www.aafp.org/news/family-doc-focus/20200224fdf-bisgrove.html): Profile of Dr. Joanna Bisgrove's advocacy journey in family medicine
- [Capt. Spencer Fray: Air Force Leadership Legacy](https://www.aafp.org/news/family-doc-focus/20220201fdf-fray.html): Profile of U.S. Air Force Capt. Spencer Fray's family medicine leadership
- [Dr. A.D. Brickler II: 65-Year Family Medicine Career](https://www.aafp.org/news/family-doc-focus/20190520fdf-brickler.html): Profile of Dr. A.D. Brickler II's distinguished 65-year family medicine career
